stories.title: Sonam Wangchuk challenges Ladakh movement restrictions
stories.summary: Ladakh activist Sonam Wangchuk described his movement restrictions as bad in law, arbitrary, vague and disproportionate. The administration invoked Section 163 of the BNSS to move him from a protest site to his residence. He has requested clarification on the 60-day order limiting his speech and movement.

stories.title: Leh Apex Body begins indefinite sit-in
stories.summary: The Leh Apex Body has launched an indefinite sit-in in Leh to protest the Ministry of Home Affairs failing to resume talks. The group also opposes holding hill council elections during winter. Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk was barred from joining the demonstration, which remains ongoing at NDS Memorial Park.

stories.title: AIMIM and Azad Samaj Party form alliance for UP polls
stories.summary: The All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen and Azad Samaj Party have formed the Samajik Parivartan Morcha to contest the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections. Asaduddin Owaisi announced Chandra Shekhar Azad as the alliance's chief ministerial candidate, stating the goal is to stop the BJP from winning a third term.

stories.title: Kejriwal receives death threat from Lawrence Bishnoi gang
stories.summary: The Lawrence Bishnoi gang has allegedly threatened to kill former Delhi chief minister Arvind Kejriwal and his daughter unless a 7 crore extortion demand is met. A case has been registered at Mohali's Cyber Crime Police Station, where officials are currently examining IP logs and call records.

stories.title: Amish Shah discusses US-India relations
stories.summary: Physician and former state legislator Amish Shah was elected to Congress after flipping Arizona's 1st district. In an interview, he discussed his family's history and the future of US-India ties. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Modi criticizes opposition over entitlement
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi accused political opponents of carrying the Constitution in their pockets while maintaining an undue sense of entitlement. Speaking at the Bharat Kisan Conclave, he described the behavior as a strange kind of intoxication of power, despite those individuals no longer holding government office.

stories.title: Ladakh activist placed under house arrest
stories.summary: Leh Apex Body member Sonam Wangchuk was placed under house arrest ahead of the December 4 hill council elections. The Leh SSP issued preventive orders citing concerns that his activities and attempts to instigate the public have previously affected order. The activist remains restricted to his residence.

stories.title: Wangchuk seeks legal clarity on movement restrictions
stories.summary: Sonam Wangchuk has written to the Ladakh administration to challenge a 60-day order restricting his movement. He alleges he was placed under house arrest without formal direction or legal justification. The order was issued under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita on November 11.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav predicts BJP vote share decline
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party president Akhilesh Yadav welcomed the new Samajik Parivartan Morcha alliance between AIMIM and the Azad Samaj Party. Yadav predicted the coalition would cost the ruling BJP 2-3 percent of the vote in the upcoming 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections.

stories.title: Three killed on Delhi-Mumbai Expressway
stories.summary: Three people, including a National Highways Authority of India employee, were killed early Thursday after a speeding MG Hector struck them while they were changing a tyre in Alwar. Police confirmed the incident occurred near the Gurjar Khora culvert at approximately 1.30 am.

stories.title: History-sheeter hacked to death in Jaipur
stories.summary: A 25-year-old man with 15 criminal cases was chased in his Toyota Fortuner and hacked to death by four to six men in Jaipur on Wednesday night. CCTV footage shows the attackers ramming his vehicle before repeatedly attacking him with axes on a residential street.

stories.title: Ghaziabad man arrested for murder
stories.summary: A 22-year-old man was arrested for allegedly murdering his friend on November 7. Police stated the accused was upset over the victim's friendship with his younger sister. The accused reportedly lured the victim to a secluded spot before the killing. One accomplice remains at large.

stories.title: Fire destroys homes in Arunachal Pradesh
stories.summary: A massive fire in Parsi Parlo killed four people, including three children and a woman, and destroyed 25 houses early Thursday. Officials suspect the blaze originated in a kitchen. The victims were identified as a mother and her three children. The cause remains under investigation.

stories.title: Singapore-based executive murdered in Faridabad
stories.summary: Security footage captured the fatal shooting of Singapore-based executive Paramjith Dhankhar by his neighbour, Mohan Sharma, following a dispute over a pet dog and parking. The accused allegedly wished the victim and his wife a festive greeting as the victim lay injured on the ground.

stories.title: Delhi man sentenced for raping minor
stories.summary: A 63-year-old Delhi man received a 20-year jail term for repeatedly raping a minor living in his building. The case emerged in February 2025 after the victim was found to be pregnant. The court also imposed a fine of 1.10 lakh on the convict.

stories.title: Man arrested for Gurugram bus stand shooting
stories.summary: A 21-year-old man, identified as Jatin, was arrested for the November 9 murder of a 35-year-old man at the Sidhravali bus stand. Police allege the killing stemmed from previous enmity. Authorities are currently searching for an associate who was also involved in the crime.

stories.title: Chauri Chaura Express derails in Kanpur
stories.summary: Four coaches of the Gorakhpur-bound Chauri Chaura Express derailed while departing Kanpur Central station on Wednesday evening. Railway officials reported no casualties among passengers. The derailment involved one trolley from each of the four affected coaches. The cause of the incident is under review.

stories.title: A2B secures $180 million investment from Bodhi Tree
stories.summary: Homegrown food chain Adyar Ananda Bhavan has secured $180 million from Bodhi Tree Systems, a firm co-founded by James Murdoch and Uday Shankar. The 50-year-old brand sold a majority stake in a deal valuing the company at roughly $350 million. The funds are earmarked for market expansion.

stories.title: Women in tech discuss entrepreneurship hurdles
stories.summary: The Department of Electronics, IT and Biotechnology hosted a session for women entrepreneurs in Bengaluru to address operational hurdles and align state policies with industry needs. The discussion preceded the 29th Bengaluru Tech Summit, focusing on moving from policy intent to action for women in the technology sector.

stories.title: Kerala shifts startup mission to scale-up mission
stories.summary: Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan announced a shift in strategy for the Kerala State Startup Mission, aiming to transform it into a scale-up mission. The state currently hosts 9,200 startups employing over 76,000 people. The government is now prioritising the quality of enterprises over the quantity of new firms.

stories.title: Kerala to launch research-driven incubators
stories.summary: Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan announced a strategy shift from quantity to quality for the state startup ecosystem. Kerala plans to establish 10 research-driven incubators and nurture 100 high-revenue startups. The initiative builds on the technology startup policy first introduced by the state government in 2014.

stories.title: Korean firms commit to Tamil Nadu investments
stories.summary: South Korean automotive suppliers Seoyon E-Hwa and Hwashin Automotive have committed to investing ₹1,370 crore in Tamil Nadu. Both companies are key suppliers to Hyundai Motor India and other automotive manufacturers. Formal agreements are expected to be signed at the upcoming state investment conclave.

stories.title: India drops in climate performance index
stories.summary: India ranked 28th in the Climate Change Performance Index released at COP31, falling five spots from last year. The index monitors 64 countries and the EU, noting that no nation performed well enough to achieve a very high rating. The countries listed account for 90% of global emissions.

stories.title: Ammonia levels threaten Delhi water supply
stories.summary: Ammonia concentrations in the Yamuna at Wazirabad have reached 2 parts per million, exceeding the 0.9 parts per million threshold for safe water treatment. The spike highlights the capital's vulnerability to upstream pollution from untreated sewage and industrial effluents. The river remains a complex source of water.

stories.title: Gurugram bans coal and wood for tandoors
stories.summary: Gurugram has prohibited the use of coal and wood in tandoors at hotels and eateries under revised Graded Response Action Plan norms. Businesses must now use electricity, gas, or other approved clean fuels to comply with the new air pollution regulations. The tandoors are being forced to adapt.

stories.title: Vizhinjam port railway tunnel costs questioned
stories.summary: The state government plans to construct a railway tunnel to Vizhinjam International Seaport costing over ₹1,500 crore. Experts and members of the public have raised concerns regarding the environmental and social costs of the project, noting that an alternative land alignment was available for the rail connection.

stories.title: Eight dead in Brooklyn building collapse
stories.summary: At least eight people have died following the collapse of a three-story building in Brooklyn. Seventeen people were injured, including three firefighters, as rescue teams continue to search the rubble. Mayor Zohran Mamdani stated that there are no words for a loss of this magnitude.

stories.title: Retail inflation exceeds RBI target
stories.summary: India's retail inflation reached 6.09 percent in October, breaching the Reserve Bank of India's 6 percent upper tolerance limit. Food inflation rose to 8.94 percent, marking the 12th consecutive month of price acceleration. The data reflects the first breach since the new retail inflation series began in 2026.

stories.title: Piyush Goyal expects strong US trade deal
stories.summary: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal stated that India will secure one of the best trade deals with the US. While a framework was finalised in February, recent changes in the US tariff landscape have prompted further negotiations. The minister maintains that the outcomes will be positive.

stories.title: US Congress considers role in Iran conflict
stories.summary: The new US Congress, set to be sworn in on January 3, holds the power to influence the conflict through federal funding decisions. While the president maintains authority, lawmakers may pressure the administration to end the war. The Constitution grants Congress the power of the purse.

stories.title: Manchester United sacks Michael Carrick
stories.summary: Manchester United fired manager Michael Carrick following the club's worst league start in 40 years. The team currently sits 18th in the 20-team standings. Carrick was dismissed less than six months after signing a two-year contract to revive the club's performance.

stories.title: Consumer prices rise across multiple sectors
stories.summary: Prices for essential goods including milk, cigarettes, and detergents have increased in various markets. Mother Dairy raised milk prices by up to ₹4 per litre, citing higher procurement costs. Commercial LPG cylinders have also become more expensive for the second consecutive month.

stories.title: Retail inflation hits 6.09 percent in October
stories.summary: Retail inflation rose to 6.09 percent in October, driven by elevated food prices and an unfavourable base effect. This is the first time the index has breached the Reserve Bank of India's 6 percent limit since the new series launched in January 2026. Food inflation reached 8.94 percent.

stories.title: Moody’s raises India’s FY27 growth forecast to 7%
stories.summary: Moody’s has raised its 2026-27 growth forecast for India to 7% from 6.5%, citing resilient consumption and investment dynamics. The agency expects growth to sustain near 7% over the medium term. The revision follows a similar move by the World Bank, which recently projected 7.1% growth for India.

stories.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO
stories.summary: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO and board member with immediate effect. CFO Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor. Harvey C. Jones has been appointed as the company's first-ever board chairman. The transition is underway.

stories.title: US lawmakers to probe Trump administration
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump has suggested former Apple CEO Tim Cook as a potential replacement for Nvidia's outgoing leader, Jensen Huang. Nvidia has denied wrongdoing regarding its business dealings and stated it has no reason to believe its trade secrets or national security interests have been compromised.

stories.title: Nvidia stock falls following leadership change
stories.summary: Nvidia shares fell 7.80% in early trading after Jensen Huang resigned as CEO. While rivals like AMD and Broadcom saw gains, Nvidia-backed CoreWeave dropped 14% and Nebius fell 20%. The broader market faced pressure as the chipmaker began its search for a new permanent leader.

stories.title: Colette Kress takes helm at Nvidia
stories.summary: CFO Colette Kress has been appointed interim CEO following the departure of Jensen Huang. Kress, who joined Nvidia in 2013, will manage the chipmaker as it navigates the transition. The company's processors currently power many of the world's most advanced supercomputers and AI data centres.

stories.title: Nvidia loses its AI architect
stories.summary: Jensen Huang has stepped down as president, CEO and board member of Nvidia. CFO Colette Kress will lead the company as interim CEO during the search for a successor. Harvey Jones has been named the first board chairman. Shares fell more than 10% following the announcement.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns
stories.summary: Jensen Huang is stepping down as Nvidia CEO and will not remain on the board. The company appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO. Reports of an extramarital affair involving Huang and a businesswoman suspected of spying for Beijing preceded the board meeting to consider his ouster.

stories.title: Sundar Pichai leads global Indian business list
stories.summary: Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai topped the 2026 HSBC Hurun Global Indians List, with his company valued at $4.2 trillion. The list features 236 leaders of Indian origin heading companies outside India. Combined, these firms generated $2.5 trillion in revenue last year, marking a significant increase in total valuation.

stories.title: Reports detail Nvidia CEO's undisclosed relationship
stories.summary: The New York Times reported that Jensen Huang maintained an undisclosed relationship with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia's vice president of health care. Former staff members alleged the two were captured on video being affectionate at a hotel during a company conference in March. Both individuals are married to others.

stories.title: Nvidia begins search for new CEO
stories.summary: Nvidia has appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO following the resignation of Jensen Huang. The board stated it will consider both internal and external candidates for the permanent role. Kress will continue her existing duties as executive vice president and CFO during the transition period.

stories.title: Nvidia exit creates market uncertainty
stories.summary: Nvidia shares fell following reports of Jensen Huang's departure amid allegations of extramarital affairs. While investors sold stocks linked to the chipmaker, rivals like Broadcom and AMD saw shares advance. Nvidia has appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO while it searches for a permanent replacement.

stories.title: WHO reports 10.6 million TB cases globally
stories.summary: The WHO estimates 10.6 million people fell ill with tuberculosis in 2025, with India accounting for nearly 25% of the global burden. India has recorded a 38% reduction in TB mortality since 2015, outperforming the global average decline of 35% over the same period.

stories.title: Government bans lithium-ion black mass exports
stories.summary: The government has prohibited the export of lithium-ion battery black mass to retain critical minerals like lithium, cobalt and nickel for domestic recycling. The Directorate General of Foreign Trade issued the notification on November 10, placing the material into the prohibited category with immediate effect.

stories.title: India reports 38% drop in TB mortality
stories.summary: India has achieved a 38% reduction in tuberculosis mortality since 2015, according to the WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2026. The country also maintains a 94% treatment success rate for drug-susceptible TB. India remains one of the 30 countries accounting for 88% of new global cases.

stories.title: Asian Stroke Summer School begins
stories.summary: The third Asian Stroke Summer School is being held in Thiruvananthapuram from November 12 to 15. Organised by SCTIMST and the University of Bern, the programme provides team-based training for neurologists and interventionalists. The course aims to advance comprehensive stroke care through hands-on skill development.

stories.title: Health Minister warns Jan Aushadhi centres
stories.summary: Health Minister U.T. Khader warned that action will be taken against Jan Aushadhi centres found selling branded medicines or violating operational norms. Inspections revealed that some centres have sold unauthorised drugs. The minister stated the Union government must ensure strict compliance with the permitted medicine list.

stories.title: Expired medicine allegedly given to children
stories.summary: Parents at a primary health centre in Palakkad alleged that children were given paracetamol syrup that had expired in October 2026. The centre replaced the medicine after complaints were lodged. Local workers staged a protest, accusing the health staff of negligence regarding the immunisation visit.

stories.title: Kerala High Court orders mental health centre improvements
stories.summary: The Kerala High Court has directed the state government to ensure mental health centres are equipped with adequate medicines and vehicles by November 24. Judges noted that assurances must translate into action. The government is also expected to report on ongoing construction and staffing progress by the deadline.

stories.title: Indian Academy of Sciences holds 92nd annual meeting
stories.summary: The 92nd annual meeting of the Indian Academy of Sciences begins Friday at the National Centre for Earth Science Studies in Thiruvananthapuram. The event gathers researchers and academicians to discuss the importance of strengthening scientific research and education. Eminent scientists from across the country are scheduled to attend.

stories.title: ISRO tests modified PSLV third stage
stories.summary: ISRO has conducted a ground static test of the PSLV third stage at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre. The agency revisited design margins and quality checks following anomalies in two previous missions. The workhorse launcher is currently undergoing efforts to restore its reliability. The stage has been revisited.

stories.title: ISRO completes static test of PSLV third stage
stories.summary: ISRO has successfully tested a modified third stage for its Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle. The test follows two consecutive mission failures linked to stage anomalies. The agency says it comprehensively reviewed design margins and assembly procedures to improve reliability. The rocket is now moving toward further planned checks.

stories.title: Religious remarks spark political friction
stories.summary: Comments by Dhirendra Krishna Shastri contrasting Lord Ram and Lord Krishna have triggered a public row. The remarks have exposed tensions among religious leaders and political parties. Historically, the worship of multiple deities has not been a contentious issue for many Hindus, regardless of their specific tutelary deity.

stories.title: Morning news brief for November 12
stories.summary: The morning briefing covers developments including the disappearance of two Special Police Officers in Kishtwar and updates on corporate and sports figures. The full piece is for subscribers. The news cycle continues to move regardless of the morning headlines.

stories.title: PM Modi sends Diwali greetings to Sam Pitroda
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi extended Diwali greetings to Sam Pitroda, the head of the Congress overseas wing. The exchange follows public remarks from Pitroda regarding his personal respect for the Prime Minister. The full details of the interaction are currently unavailable due to server access restrictions.

stories.title: Sam Pitroda and PM Modi exchange public greetings
stories.summary: Sam Pitroda, a frequent critic of the government, recently described Prime Minister Narendra Modi as a warm and kind Gujarati friend. The Prime Minister responded with Diwali greetings and well wishes for Pitroda and his wife. The festive season has produced a rare moment of public bonhomie.
